values.meaning: channel duration before the portal completes
values.quote: channels for 2 seconds to open a portal

mechanics.claim: Overload and Spell Flux empowered damage is increased by the bonus amount while Realm Warp is ranked.
Ryze can act (cast abilities, attack) during the channel; it cancels only if he is interrupted.
mechanics.quote: '''Ryze''' is able to act while channeling, but the portal will cancel if he is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}.

mechanics.claim: The root/disarm/silence/untargetable effect applies to allies and Ryze upon arrival, which is defensive not offensive utility for a stationary dummy fight.
mechanics.quote: '''Ryze''' and all allied units within the portal will {{tip|blink}} to the location and become {{tip|root|rooted}}, {{tip|disarm|disarmed}}, {{tip|silence|silenced}} and {{tip|untargetable}}
